text.en:
There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Director of Higher Education, a school
of arts and trades in the Municipality of Cagwait, Province of Surigao del Sur, to be known as the Cagwait
School of Arts and Trades. Academic, industrial and vocational courses shall be offered in said school.

The amount of one hundred fifty thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded
out of the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 for the Ministry of Education and Culture
intended for new national schools of trade. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operations and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 14, 1982
